source.title: Armagh Guardian, 23 May 1952, p. 1 ("County and Rural Council Elections: No Contests in County and Armagh Rural")
source.publisher: Armagh Guardian (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: names from the OCR text of the page, which is clean (not compared line by line with the image); returned unopposed, no poll

note: Triennial election of the county council, 1952: nominations 20 May 1952; every seat returned unopposed. The list prints no party labels (so none are given) and has no entry for Crossmore. Returned unopposed. William Cooke: no party label printed in 1952. At other elections he stood as Unionist (Newtownhamilton, Newry No. 2 Rural District, 2 June 1949, printed 'Unionist': Newry Telegraph, 21 May 1949, p. 3 ("Newry No. 2 (Co. Armagh) Rural District Council (election nominations)"); Frontier Sentinel, 21 May 1949, p. 3 ("Newry and Kilkeel Rural Councils' Nominations")).
